children: Shares of Waaree Renewable Technologies surged 13 percent to Rs 777.5 in morning trade on Friday, November 27, after the company secured an order for a 120 megawatt-peak (MWp) solar project. The stock was among the top smallcap gainers, taking the company’s market capitalisation to about Rs 8,050 crore.

The Waaree Energies subsidiary said it received the letter of award after market hours on Thursday. Under the turnkey contract, Waaree Renewable Technologies will supply the solar modules and carry out the engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) work for the project.

A domestic private limited company awarded the contract, and the project is scheduled for completion in the financial year ending March 2028. Waaree Renewable Technologies did not disclose the customer’s name or the contract value. It said the order did not constitute a related-party transaction and that its promoter, promoter group and group companies had no interest in the customer.

The stock’s double-digit rise came as smallcaps and midcaps advanced even as the benchmark Nifty 50 edged lower. The Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 0.9 percent to 19,547.8 and the Nifty Midcap 100 gained 0.9 percent to 62,309.9, while the Nifty 50 slipped 0.2 percent to 25,841.
Friday’s rally pared Waaree Renewable Technologies’ losses for the year. The stock was still down 20 percent year to date, compared with a 1.2 percent decline in the Nifty 50.

Waaree Renewable Technologies reported a net profit of Rs 82 crore for the September quarter of FY27, down 30 percent from Rs 116 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations rose 36.5 percent to Rs 1,057.8 crore from Rs 775 crore.

Operating earnings grew much more slowly than revenue. Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose 1.3 percent to Rs 160 crore from Rs 158 crore, while the EBITDA margin narrowed by five percentage points to 15 percent.

title: Waaree Renewable Technologies shares surge 13% after 120 MWp solar project win
